interpretation: Known assistant-reviewed synthetic cases: 16 total, 8 evaluation; no independent legal gold or measured output precision.
Target ID hits and original-source bindings do not certify reasons, factual correctness or legal applicability.
Every hint on clear negatives counts, including unannotated norms. Explicit no_hint violations are a separate subset; zero there is not zero false outputs.
Technical errors and insufficient-context answers remain distinct from successful abstention. The context-annotated case is not relabelled as a clear negative.
Prepared whole-source arms and automatic retrieval arms are distinct. Lexical evaluation is a later exploratory eight-case arm using inherited facts.
Identical recorded requests produced different answers in a repeated 9B decision; individual lexical improvements cannot all be attributed solely to changed source selection.
Model sizes, quantization and offload differ together; this comparison does not isolate any one of them or establish a VRAM quality ceiling.
Timing scopes differ. Physical fact calls are counted once; standalone structured/lexical durations include shared historical fact work and must not be summed as new physical time.
This collector validates receipt links and selected counters from passed independent audits; it does not rerun models, raw trajectory audits or external weight hashing.

physical_execution.scope: Only decisions are new work; inherited facts belong to the matched primary run. Standalone time adds historical facts; end verification is separate.
